verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents AuthKit Connect explicitly for this use case: 'A third-party OAuth application will generally have a "Sign in with [your application]" button on their login page,' plus AuthKit itself is described as a 'spec-compatible OAuth authorization server,' and M2M application support lets partners get programmatic API credentials. This directly matches turning a developer's app into an OAuth provider issuing tokens to third parties. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer confirmation of setting up an OAuth app via AuthKit Connect, and deeper documentation of the token issuance/consent flow specifics beyond marketing-style docs snippets.
